memory.remembered: Saved to materials as a memory command
memory.allGone: None of these materials are in the library anymore (they may have been deleted already)
memory.notOnCard: Only materials listed on the card can be deleted. These aren't on it: {ids}
memory.range.reversed: The time range starts after it ends
memory.plugin.title: Memory
memory.plugin.summary: Turns what you've said into materials; remember, forget, delete completely and don't infer commands; ergo searches memory when answering
memory.plugin.purge.remember: What you asked ergo to "remember" (the text in those memory commands)
memory.plugin.purge.stale: Records of suggestion and question cards left unhandled for a long time
memory.plugin.purge.cards: Every version of memory deletion cards (in chats and the inbox)
memory.plugin.purge.nightly: Nightly consolidation records (each night's report and any failure item in the inbox)
memory.plugin.keep.materials: Materials in the library (what you've said, saved web pages, things to remember): materials belong to the core — to delete them, use bulk delete in Memory · Materials (Settings · Delete materials when the Memory plugin is gone)
memory.plugin.keep.commands: Records of forget, delete completely and don't infer commands: they note which materials were deleted; without them, deleted materials would come back on a rebuild
memory.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (goes away as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
memory.plugin.keep.reasoning: The reasoning DB (memory/subtext/rg.db in the data directory) is kept: it holds conclusions consolidated from materials and the consolidation records; rebuilding needs only the materials and loses no originals. Disabling or removing never deletes it
memory.plugin.keep.originals: Not one original material is touched: the reasoning DB only references materials, it never copies or rewrites them
memory.nightly.failed.title: Memory consolidation didn't finish ({night})
memory.nightly.failed.body: The 03:00 consolidation failed: {reason}. No material was lost; the next consolidation picks up where this one stopped.
memory.nightly.rebuild.title: Memory consolidation needs a rebuilt reasoning DB
memory.nightly.rebuild.body: The reasoning DB (memory/subtext/rg.db in the data directory) doesn't match this version of ergo: {reason}. It was not migrated automatically; no material was lost, and rebuilding the reasoning DB loses no originals.
memory.nightly.reason.noKey: No DeepSeek key (environment variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) is configured, so this consolidation is skipped
memory.nightly.reason.busy: The previous consolidation is still running, so this one doesn't start on top of it: check the consolidation record when it finishes
memory.nightly.manual.title: Consolidate memory now
memory.nightly.manual.done: Consolidated: {newClaims} new conclusions, {changedClaims} changed, {open} questions open; {modelCalls} model calls this time
memory.nightly.manual.budget: (budget used up; the next consolidation continues)
memory.nightly.manual.off: Memory consolidation is turned off on this machine (memory.enabled is false)
memory.nightly.reason.timeout: Consolidation timed out: still not done after {minutes} minutes, so this night gives up (no material was lost; the next night runs as usual)
memory.nightly.issue.manifestMissing: The reasoning DB has no manifest (it may be from an older version, or the file isn't a reasoning DB)
memory.nightly.issue.schemaMismatch: The reasoning DB format version is {found}, and this version of ergo expects {expected}
memory.nightly.issue.storeSchemaMismatch: The reasoning DB table version is {found}, and this version of ergo expects {expected}
memory.graph.notBuilt: The reasoning DB hasn't been built yet: it exists after the nightly consolidation runs for the first time (that run needs a DeepSeek key configured)
memory.graph.busy: The nightly consolidation is using the reasoning DB right now; refresh again in a moment
memory.graph.readFailed: The reasoning DB can't be read: {detail}
memory.unknownMode: This version doesn't know this deletion mode ({mode})
memory.tool.woven: Note a question asked in passing
memory.curator.label: Memory curator
memory.curator.interrupted: The memory curator was interrupted before it finished; ask it again if you need it
memory.curator.interruptedQuoted: The memory curator was interrupted before it finished (it was working on: {quoted}); ask it again if you need it
memory.prompt.flag: True while the memory plugin is running (false when it's disabled in config plugins.disabled or failed to load): wraps the parts about memory commands (remember, forget, delete completely, don't infer), searching and reading materials, and the memory curator
memory.prompt.toolNameAskCurator: Tool name (memory plugin: ask the memory curator)
memory.plugin.purge.interviews: Get-to-know interview records (invites, starts and ends; what you said in interviews is material and stays)
memory.interview.card.weeklyTitle: Got 10 minutes to chat? This time: {topic}
memory.interview.card.monthlyTitle: Anything changed lately you'd like to talk about?
memory.interview.endedCovered_one: This interview is over: "{topic}" is marked as covered. The {n} thing you said is saved as material marked "from interview" and will be used in tonight's consolidation; the curator's summary is not written as a conclusion.
memory.interview.endedCovered_other: This interview is over: "{topic}" is marked as covered. The {n} things you said are saved as material marked "from interview" and will be used in tonight's consolidation; the curator's summary is not written as a conclusion.
memory.interview.endedOpen_one: Stopping here for now: "{topic}" isn't finished, we'll pick it up next time. The {n} thing you said is saved as material marked "from interview".
memory.interview.endedOpen_other: Stopping here for now: "{topic}" isn't finished, we'll pick it up next time. The {n} things you said are saved as material marked "from interview".
memory.interview.action.title: Start a get-to-know interview
memory.interview.action.done: The interview has started ({topic}); the memory curator is waiting: open the Memory page and tap “Talk to the memory curator”.
memory.interview.action.already: An interview is already going on ({topic}); open the Memory page and tap “Talk to the memory curator” to continue.
memory.plugin.interviewFilesCard: Interview profile check card (checked item by item when an interview wraps up)
memory.plugin.purge.interviewCards: Every version of interview invite cards and interview profile check cards (in chats and the inbox; what's already in your profiles stays)
memory.interview.files.inboxTitle: Profile details from the interview, please check each one
memory.interview.files.title: Profile details from the interview ({n})
memory.interview.files.unknownItem: That item isn't on this card
memory.interview.files.decided: That item has already been handled
memory.learned.notReady: Memory hasn't been consolidated yet (the reasoning store isn't ready)
memory.doctor.index.title: Vector index
memory.doctor.index.off: The material store isn't collecting materials right now, so there's no vector index
memory.doctor.index.error: Computing vectors failed; it retries in a minute ({indexed} done, {pending} to go)
memory.doctor.index.noModel: The vector model {model} isn't installed: materials can only be found by keyword, not by meaning ({pending} still without vectors)
memory.doctor.index.behind: {pending} of {total} materials still have no vectors ({state}); those can only be found by keyword
memory.doctor.index.ok: Vectors are ready for all {indexed} materials
memory.doctor.fix.indexError: Look for the vector error in the log; if it keeps happening, restart ergo
memory.doctor.fix.indexModel: Install the vector model in Settings · Components; it catches up by itself, no restart needed
memory.doctor.fix.indexBehind: It's catching up in the background: check again in a while, and restart ergo if it doesn't move
memory.doctor.graph.title: Reasoning DB
memory.doctor.graph.rebuild: The reasoning DB needs to be rebuilt: {reason}
memory.doctor.graph.unusable: {reason}: asking memory and memory briefs can't use it right now
memory.doctor.graph.off: Memory consolidation is turned off on this machine (memory.enabled is false), and there's no reasoning DB yet
memory.doctor.graph.missing: The reasoning DB file is missing: asking memory and memory briefs come back empty
memory.doctor.graph.notLoaded: The reasoning DB exists ({size} MB), but it wasn't built yet when asking memory and memory briefs first needed it, so they won't open it until ergo restarts
memory.doctor.graph.inUse: Usable; asking memory and memory briefs are using it ({size} MB)
memory.doctor.graph.checked: Checked at startup: it opens ({size} MB)
memory.doctor.graph.notOpened: It exists ({size} MB) and hasn't been used since ergo started
memory.doctor.fix.graphRebuild: The reasoning DB doesn't match this version of ergo and isn't migrated automatically; no material was lost. There's no rebuild button yet, so please report this to us
memory.doctor.fix.graphOpen: Check free disk space and the permissions of the data directory, then restart ergo and run the checkup again
memory.doctor.fix.graphMissing: Restarting ergo builds it again; no material was lost, and later consolidations work the conclusions out again
memory.doctor.fix.graphRestart: Restart ergo and they'll use it
memory.doctor.system.title: Memory system
memory.doctor.system.none: No memory system is running: memory briefs and "remember this" don't work
memory.doctor.fix.systemNone: Restart ergo; if that doesn't help, look in the log for why the memory plugin didn't start
memory.doctor.fix.systemProblems: Look into what it says; also check the reasoning DB item in this block
memory.doctor.brief.title: Memory brief
memory.doctor.brief.off: Memory briefs are turned off on the Memory page
memory.doctor.brief.slow: Since {from}: {asked} asked, {timedOut} timed out, {failed} failed ({ratio}); the last one took {last} s
memory.doctor.brief.ok: Since {from}: {asked} asked, {timedOut} timed out, {failed} failed; the last one took {last} s
memory.doctor.fix.briefSlow: A turn that takes longer than {seconds} s goes without memory. Usually the vector model is slow or the reasoning DB is large: restart ergo and check again, and report this to us if it keeps happening
memory.doctor.nightly.title: Nightly consolidation
memory.doctor.nightly.off: Memory consolidation is turned off on this machine (memory.enabled is false)
memory.doctor.nightly.rebuild: The consolidation on {time} needs the reasoning DB rebuilt first: {reason} ({lastOk})
memory.doctor.nightly.never: The nightly consolidation has been scheduled since {time} and hasn't succeeded once
memory.doctor.nightly.notYet: Not consolidated yet: it runs every night at 03:00
memory.doctor.nightly.stale: The last successful consolidation was {hours} hours ago ({time}); none has succeeded since
memory.doctor.nightly.timedOutCurator: the memory curator's turn was stopped first and the consolidation finished in the background
memory.doctor.nightly.timedOutOther: it went over the time limit
memory.doctor.nightly.timedOut: Succeeded on {time}, but timed out along the way: {details}
memory.doctor.nightly.reran: The consolidation for the night of {night} ran twice: the first run timed out and it ran again
memory.doctor.fix.nightlyFailed: No material was lost; the next night at 03:00 picks up where this stopped. If several nights in a row fail, check the consolidation records on the memory curator's page
memory.doctor.fix.nightlySkipped: Configure a DeepSeek key (environment variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) and restart ergo; the next night runs as usual
memory.doctor.fix.nightlyStale: Ergo needs to be running at 03:00; check the consolidation records on the memory curator's page for why it didn't succeed
memory.doctor.fix.nightlyTimedOut: No conclusions were lost that night; if it happens several nights in a row, please report this to us
memory.doctor.presync.title: Data source import before consolidation
memory.doctor.presync.none: No data source has been imported before a consolidation yet (none is set to import and pullable by this computer, or there hasn't been a consolidation)
memory.doctor.presync.noSources: There were no data sources to import before consolidating
memory.doctor.presync.bad_one: Before the consolidation on {time}, {count} data source wasn't imported: {list}
memory.doctor.presync.bad_other: Before the consolidation on {time}, {count} data sources weren't imported: {list}
memory.doctor.presync.ok: Before the consolidation on {time}, everything was imported: {list}
memory.doctor.presync.item.timeout: {name} (still importing after {minutes} min; the next consolidation reads it)
memory.doctor.fix.presync: Check these in Settings · Data sources; whatever wasn't imported this time is read by the next consolidation
